snippet.title: Choppy Cuts Official Trailer | Today is the day! Choppy Cuts' soft opening has officially begun!
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to announce that the public demo of Choppy Cuts is now available on Steam starting August 9th. Grab your friends and dive into the fun of running your own hair salon!

Don't forget to add us to your Steam Wishlist and follow our social media for all the latest updates.
We'd love to hear your experiences and feedback in our official communities as we embark on this exciting journey together! Happy styling!

Steam:  Choppy Cuts
Instagram:  cc.choppycuts
